related_work.work_intent_goal: Mature mncs-compiler for reliable native multi-module application development while advancing verified self-consumption

active_control_projection_after_local_ad.interpretation: The authenticated Control path still runs the integrated Environment version; this feature branch is not yet deployed there.

outcome.analysis_limit: One bounded Compiler page shows a source-format integration gap. It does not establish that compiler measurements were never recorded elsewhere, nor that this gap recurs across campaigns.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Compiler regression evidence is absent from environmental capability observations
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The authenticated Compiler campaign page contains a content-addressed language-module regression record, while the environmental-capability projection reports zero observation references for that page. The record has direct per-build resource and fact-reuse measurements that are not available in the capability observation view.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Add a bounded, schema-aware adapter for the established Compiler regression record, retaining the original commit and SHA-256 and preserving unavailable measurements.
